title: List the ID and sex of the oldest male patient who has a normal creatinine
question: List the ID and sex of the oldest male patient who has a normal creatinine level (CRE < 1.5) and whose anti-Cardiolipin IgA antibody level is among the top 5 highest values recorded.

prediction.sql:
WITH Top5Antibody AS (
    SELECT
        P."XCL_058" AS PatientID,
        P."XCL_059" AS Sex,
        P."XCL_060" AS BirthDate,
        L."XCL_024" AS AntibodyLevel,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY L."XCL_024" DESC) AS Rank
    FROM Patient P
    INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
    WHERE P."XCL_059" = 'M'
      AND L."XCL_056" < 1.5
)
SELECT
    PatientID AS ID,
    Sex
FROM Top5Antibody
WHERE Rank <= 5
ORDER BY BirthDate ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH Top5Antibody AS (
    SELECT
        P."XCL_058" AS PatientID,
        P."XCL_059" AS Sex,
        P."XCL_060" AS BirthDate,
        L."XCL_024" AS AntibodyLevel,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY L."XCL_024" DESC) AS Rank
    FROM Patient P
    INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
    WHERE P."XCL_059" = 'M'
      AND L."XCL_056" < 1.5
)
SELECT
    PatientID AS ID,
    Sex
FROM Top5Antibody
WHERE Rank <= 5
ORDER BY BirthDate ASC
LIMIT 1
